title: [Report] HTML anchor links opens new tiddler
body:
**Problem Description** I found that footnote links opens a new tiddler when using the markdown plugin. After further investigation, I found that v5.3.8 markdown plugin on tiddlywiki v5.4.0-pre also has this problem. It turned out that tiddlywiki's support for HTML anchor links no longer works. **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to https://tiddlywiki.com/prerelease/#Anchor%20Links%20using%20HTML 2. Click one of the links. It will open a new tiddler. **Expected behavior** Anchor links shouldn't open a new tiddler. **TiddlyWiki Configuration** This can be replicated with empty tiddlywiki v5.4.0-pre.
